built: 2026-11-19 (MT) v1.2.11: room v1.2.11 factory.js is the base (featured addon, https-only post images). The stories cluster (48 functions) loads lazily from same-origin factory-stories.js only when stories are on. Core 224213 B, budget 226000 B. factory-signin.js and factory-reports.js are unchanged.

factory-gp.js.loadWhen: site.json features.watchlist|topicFollow|sessionSeeds true, or rail.kind f1-calendar (gpchat only today)

factory-rail.js.loadWhen: site.json rail.kind nws-forecast|nws-cwf|bart-bsa, or rail.forecastUrl / rail.lat+lon (415, 808, samo, bart)

factory-reports.js.loadWhen: site.json features.reportLoop true (A9 report loop; airlineschat/amachat first once unkilled)

factory-hero.js.loadWhen: site.json heroImages with at least one fully credited, allowed item (gpchat only today); load it after factory.js. Rotating hero photo at the top of the center column; without photos it adds nothing

factory-signin.js.loadWhen: lazy, prefetched at factory boot so a Google tap can call signInWithPopup in the same gesture; a blocked popup (or a silent iOS / in-app failure) falls back to signInWithRedirect; also handles redirect result, email, register, email-already-in-use, forgot password, the join-sheet layout, and the in-app-browser Open in your browser note

factory-stories.js.loadWhen: lazy, fixed same-origin path (addon('factory-stories'), the loadSigninModule pattern) only when storiesOn() (site.stories.enabled !== false). Rooms with stories off do not request the file

factory-featured.js.loadWhen: lazy, addon('factory-featured') only when site.json has a featured block. Copy of the room file (no innerHTML; textContent and setAttribute only)
